2:216.text: Battle has been enjoined upon you while it is hateful to you. But perhaps you hate a thing and it is good for you; and perhaps you love a thing and it is bad for you. And Allāh knows, while you know not.

2:217.text: They ask you about the sacred month
- about fighting therein. Say, "Fighting therein is great
from the way of Allāh and disbelief in Him and
al-Masjid al-Ḥarām and the expulsion of its people therefrom are greater
in the sight of Allāh. And fitnah
is greater than killing." And they will continue to fight you until they turn you back from your religion if they are able. And whoever of you reverts from his religion
and dies while he is a disbeliever - for those, their deeds have become worthless in this world and the Hereafter, and those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.

2:218.text: Indeed, those who have believed and those who have emigrated and fought in the cause of Allāh - those expect the mercy of Allāh. And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

2:219.text: and gambling. Say, "In them is great sin and
benefit for people. But their sin is greater than their benefit." And they ask you what they should spend. Say, "The excess
." Thus Allāh makes clear to you the verses
